name: Deliverable issue completeness check
summary: As a calculation, report or drawing package nears issue, the quality reviewer or document controller gets a checklist: missing review records, revisions that disagree between the index, the register and the title block, and citations of out-of-date calculations. Issue stays with the engineers.

sources.title: Written by Fully Powered AI from its own published map of the work of releasing an engineering deliverable package (the trigger, inputs, output, decision and exceptions of the site's illustrative example), with the checklist tests, columns and result wording designed in the template itself.
